title: Knowledge Sovereignty
definition: The concept of complete control and ownership of knowledge by an individual or organization.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Imagine having all the answers to your questions and having full control over what you know. That's what knowledge sovereignty is about.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Knowledge sovereignty entails full ownership and control of knowledge, ensuring privacy and independence in knowledge acquisition and utilization.
difficulty_levels.expert: Knowledge sovereignty is a philosophical and practical concept that emphasizes the importance of personal knowledge ownership and control. It has implications for privacy, ethics, and intellectual property. It also raises questions about the balance between individual and collective knowledge.

extra_fields.insight: The HOG system enables complete knowledge sovereignty by enriching a permanent knowledge base with every conversation.
